# RevKeen CLI

> RevKeen CLI — manage payments, subscriptions & billing

## Commands

- `revkeen` — RevKeen CLI — manage payments, subscriptions & billing
- `revkeen analytics` — Operations on analytics
- `revkeen analytics help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen analytics revenue-mrr-summary` — MRR Summary
- `revkeen analytics revenue-time-series` — Revenue Time Series
- `revkeen api` — Make raw API requests
- `revkeen auth` — Authenticate with RevKeen
- `revkeen auth help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen auth login` — Authenticate with RevKeen
- `revkeen auth logout` — Clear stored credentials
- `revkeen auth status` — Show current authentication status
- `revkeen cart-sessions` — Operations on cart-sessions
- `revkeen cart-sessions add-line-item` — Add a line item to a cart session
- `revkeen cart-sessions apply-discount-code` — Set or clear a cart discount code
- `revkeen cart-sessions convert` — Convert a cart session into a checkout session
- `revkeen cart-sessions create` — Create a cart session
- `revkeen cart-sessions get` — Retrieve a cart session
- `revkeen cart-sessions help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen cart-sessions remove-line-item` — Remove a line item from a cart session
- `revkeen cart-sessions toggle-add-on` — Toggle an add-on on a cart session
- `revkeen cart-sessions update-line-item` — Update a line item's quantity
- `revkeen checkout-sessions` — Operations on checkout-sessions
- `revkeen checkout-sessions create` — Create a checkout session
- `revkeen checkout-sessions expire` — Expire a checkout session
- `revkeen checkout-sessions get` — Retrieve a checkout session
- `revkeen checkout-sessions help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen config` — Manage CLI configuration
- `revkeen config help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen config list` — Show current configuration
- `revkeen config set` — Set a configuration value
- `revkeen credit-notes` — Operations on credit-notes
- `revkeen credit-notes create` — Create a credit note
- `revkeen credit-notes get` — Get credit note by ID
- `revkeen credit-notes help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen credit-notes list` — List credit notes
- `revkeen credit-notes list-lines` — List line items on a credit note
- `revkeen credit-notes preview` — Preview a credit note without creating it
- `revkeen credit-notes void` — Void a credit note
- `revkeen customer-meters` — Operations on customer-meters
- `revkeen customer-meters get` — Retrieve a customer-meter aggregate
- `revkeen customer-meters help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen customer-meters list` — List a customer's meter usage
- `revkeen customer-portal` — Operations on customer-portal
- `revkeen customer-portal customer-get` — Retrieve the authenticated customer
- `revkeen customer-portal help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen customer-portal invoices-get` — Retrieve an invoice
- `revkeen customer-portal invoices-list` — List the authenticated customer's invoices
- `revkeen customer-portal sessions-create` — Create a customer-portal session
- `revkeen customer-portal subscriptions-cancel` — Cancel a subscription
- `revkeen customer-portal subscriptions-get` — Retrieve a subscription
- `revkeen customer-portal subscriptions-list` — List the authenticated customer's subscriptions
- `revkeen customers` — Operations on customers
- `revkeen customers create` — Create a new customer
- `revkeen customers get` — Get customer by ID
- `revkeen customers help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen customers list` — List customers
- `revkeen customers payment-methods-list` — Get customer payment methods
- `revkeen customers payment-rails-get` — Get customer payment rail availability
- `revkeen customers preferred-rails-get` — Get preferred payment rails
- `revkeen customers update` — Update customer details
- `revkeen entitlements` — Operations on entitlements
- `revkeen entitlements check` — Check entitlement access
- `revkeen entitlements help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen entitlements list` — List entitlements
- `revkeen events` — Operations on events
- `revkeen events get` — Retrieve an event
- `revkeen events help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen events list` — List events
- `revkeen events resend` — Resend webhook for an event
- `revkeen help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen invoices` — Operations on invoices
- `revkeen invoices create` — Create invoice
- `revkeen invoices finalize` — Finalize an invoice
- `revkeen invoices get` — Get invoice
- `revkeen invoices help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen invoices list` — List invoices
- `revkeen invoices margin-estimate` — Estimate invoice net by payment rail
- `revkeen invoices send` — Send an invoice
- `revkeen invoices update` — Update invoice
- `revkeen invoices void` — Void an invoice
- `revkeen payment-intents` — Operations on payment-intents
- `revkeen payment-intents cancel` — Cancel a payment intent
- `revkeen payment-intents capture` — Capture a payment intent
- `revkeen payment-intents confirm` — Confirm a payment intent
- `revkeen payment-intents create` — Create a payment intent
- `revkeen payment-intents get` — Retrieve a payment intent
- `revkeen payment-intents help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen payment-intents list` — List payment intents
- `revkeen payment-links` — Operations on payment-links
- `revkeen payment-links activate` — Activate a payment link (deprecated)
- `revkeen payment-links archive` — Archive a payment link (deprecated)
- `revkeen payment-links create` — Create a new payment link
- `revkeen payment-links deactivate` — Deactivate a payment link (deprecated)
- `revkeen payment-links expire` — Expire a payment link (deprecated)
- `revkeen payment-links get` — Get payment link by ID
- `revkeen payment-links help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen payment-links list` — List payment links
- `revkeen payment-links update` — Update payment link status
- `revkeen prices` — Operations on prices
- `revkeen prices archive` — Archive a price
- `revkeen prices create` — Create a price
- `revkeen prices get` — Retrieve a price
- `revkeen prices help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen prices list` — List prices
- `revkeen prices update` — Update a price
- `revkeen products` — Operations on products
- `revkeen products create` — Create product
- `revkeen products get` — Get product by ID
- `revkeen products help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen products list` — List products
- `revkeen products update` — Update product
- `revkeen refunds` — Operations on refunds
- `revkeen refunds create` — Create a refund
- `revkeen refunds get` — Get refund by ID
- `revkeen refunds help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen refunds list` — List refunds
- `revkeen subscriptions` — Operations on subscriptions
- `revkeen subscriptions cancel` — Cancel subscription
- `revkeen subscriptions create` — Create a new subscription
- `revkeen subscriptions get` — Get subscription by ID
- `revkeen subscriptions help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen subscriptions list` — List subscriptions
- `revkeen subscriptions update` — Update subscription details
- `revkeen terminal` — Manage POS terminal devices
- `revkeen terminal help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen terminal pair` — Pair a POS terminal device
- `revkeen terminal pay` — Initiate a payment on a terminal
- `revkeen terminal status` — Show status of connected terminals
- `revkeen transactions` — Operations on transactions
- `revkeen transactions get` — Get transaction by ID
- `revkeen transactions help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen transactions list` — List transactions
- `revkeen webhook-deliveries` — Operations on webhook-deliveries
- `revkeen webhook-deliveries get` — Retrieve a webhook delivery
- `revkeen webhook-deliveries help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen webhook-deliveries list` — List webhook deliveries
- `revkeen webhook-deliveries retry` — Retry a webhook delivery
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints` — Operations on webhook-endpoints
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints create` — Create webhook endpoint
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints delete` — Delete webhook endpoint
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints get` — Get webhook endpoint
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints list` — List webhook endpoints
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints rotate-secret` — Rotate signing secret
- `revkeen webhook-endpoints update` — Update webhook endpoint
- `revkeen webhooks` — Work with RevKeen webhooks
- `revkeen webhooks help` — Help about any command
- `revkeen webhooks list` — List registered webhook endpoints
- `revkeen webhooks listen` — Forward webhook events to a local URL

## Global Flags

```
      --agent            Machine-readable mode: compact JSON, no color, errors as JSON to stderr
      --api-key string   Override API key (or set REVKEEN_API_KEY)
      --json             Shorthand for --output json (pretty-printed)
      --no-color         Disable color output
  -o, --output string    Output format: table, json, yaml, csv (default "table")
      --table            Shorthand for --output table
```

## Install

```bash
npm install -g @revkeen/cli-binary
brew install revkeen/tap/revkeen
curl -fsSL https://cli.revkeen.com/install.sh | sh
```
